eyebrow.zh: AI 經濟 · 高層總覽

summary.en: A weekly operating view of the AI economy—connecting compute supply, power availability, model economics, and enterprise adoption in one decision-ready brief.
summary.zh: 每週掌握 AI 經濟的營運全貌，將算力供給、電力可用性、模型經濟與企業採用整合成一份可直接決策的情報簡報。

title.en: The constraint stack is rotating from silicon to electrons.
title.zh: 制約堆疊正從矽晶片轉向電力。

body.en: Accelerator availability is improving unevenly, but grid interconnection, generation contracts, and cooling retrofits now determine how quickly announced AI capacity becomes revenue. At the software layer, falling token prices widen adoption while shifting differentiation toward workflow ownership, proprietary context, and measurable task completion.
body.zh: 加速器供應正不均衡地改善，但電網併網、發電合約與冷卻改造，現在決定已公布的 AI 容量能多快轉化為營收。在軟體層，Token 價格下降擴大採用，同時把差異化轉向工作流程所有權、專有情境與可衡量的任務完成率。

text.en: AMD reported $6.7B of second-quarter data-center revenue, with demand spanning EPYC processors and Instinct accelerators.
text.zh: AMD 公布第二季資料中心營收為 $6.7B，需求涵蓋 EPYC 處理器與 Instinct 加速器。

text.en: Cisco reported $9.3B of hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders in its latest fiscal year, providing a new conversion signal from AI capacity plans to networking demand.
text.zh: Cisco 公布最新會計年度超大規模客戶 AI 基礎設施訂單達 $9.3B，為 AI 容量規畫轉化成網路需求提供新的落地信號。

text.en: OpenAI agreed to secure approximately 8 IT-GW at Ohio's PORTS-Pike campus, with capacity scheduled to be delivered over time.
text.zh: OpenAI 同意在俄亥俄州 PORTS-Pike 園區取得約 8 IT-GW 容量，並按進度分期交付。

risks.en: Track signed megawatts, not announced campuses. The spread between the two is becoming the best reality check on growth.
risks.zh: 追蹤已簽約的兆瓦，而不是已公布的園區。兩者之間的差距，正成為檢驗成長真實度的最佳指標。

risks.en: Watch whether price compression expands total workloads fast enough to offset falling revenue per token.
risks.zh: 觀察價格壓縮能否讓總工作負載快速擴張，足以抵銷每 Token 收入下降。

risks.en: Completion rate, human review burden, and gross margin matter more than seats or pilots.
risks.zh: 完成率、人工覆核負擔與毛利率，比席次或試點數量更重要。

eyebrow.zh: 資本層 · AI 公開市場股票

title.zh: AI 故事，最終都要接受市場定價。

summary.en: A weekly capital-markets view connecting AI infrastructure themes to public equities—tracking leadership, relative strength, valuation, earnings catalysts, and the risks hidden beneath headline momentum.
summary.zh: 每週連結 AI 基礎設施題材與公開市場股票，追蹤領漲結構、相對強弱、估值、財報催化劑，以及藏在表面動能下的風險。

title.en: The next leg needs earnings breadth, not another headline.
title.zh: 下一段行情需要獲利擴散，而不是另一則新聞標題。

body.en: AI equity leadership is widening from accelerator vendors into networking, power, cooling, and workflow software. The durable signal is no longer capex announcements alone; it is upward earnings revisions across the stack. Relative strength remains constructive, but elevated valuation makes revenue conversion and margin quality the market’s next filter.
body.zh: AI 股票領漲結構正從加速器供應商，擴散至網路、電力、冷卻與工作流程軟體。持久的信號不再只是資本支出公告，而是整個堆疊的獲利預估同步上修。相對強弱仍具建設性，但高估值讓營收轉化與利潤品質成為市場下一道篩選器。

text.en: AMD's second-quarter revenue increased 50% year over year, while data-center revenue more than doubled, adding first-party earnings breadth to AI equity leadership.
text.zh: AMD 第二季營收年增 50%，資料中心營收更成長逾一倍，為 AI 股票領漲結構增添第一方獲利擴散證據。

text.en: TSMC's second-quarter revenue reached the top of its guidance range and its third-quarter outlook stepped higher, reinforcing earnings support for advanced-node and AI infrastructure exposure.
text.zh: 台積電第二季營收達到指引區間上緣，第三季展望再向上推進，進一步支持先進製程與 AI 基礎設施相關標的的獲利動能。

risks.en: Track changes in next-twelve-month estimates. Rising prices without rising earnings create the most fragile form of AI leadership.
risks.zh: 追蹤未來十二個月的預估變化。只有股價上漲、獲利沒有上修，是最脆弱的 AI 領漲型態。

risks.en: A healthy AI cycle spreads beyond one or two mega-caps into memory, networking, power, and application leaders.
risks.zh: 健康的 AI 週期會從少數大型股，擴散到記憶體、網路、電力與應用領導者。

risks.en: Booked revenue, utilization, and free cash flow matter more than announced capacity when valuations already price in growth.
risks.zh: 當估值已反映成長時，已入帳營收、利用率與自由現金流，比公布的產能更重要。

nextObservations.zh: 下一讀 · 五十日線參與率

eyebrow.zh: 基礎設施層 · 算力與晶片

title.zh: 算力看似充足，直到它突然不足。

summary.en: A supply-chain view of accelerators, memory, packaging, and networking, built to separate durable capacity from headline announcements.
summary.zh: 從加速器、記憶體、封裝與網路供應鏈切入，區分可持續的實際產能與新聞標題中的容量承諾。

title.en: The shortage is fragmenting, not disappearing.
title.zh: 短缺正在分化，而不是消失。

body.en: General accelerator access is improving, but the premium stack remains constrained by HBM yield, advanced packaging, and high-speed networking. The strategic question is no longer simply who can buy GPUs—it is who can assemble a balanced system, secure power, and keep utilization high enough to defend returns.
body.zh: 一般加速器的取得正改善，但高階堆疊仍受 HBM 良率、先進封裝與高速網路限制。策略問題已不再只是誰能買到 GPU，而是誰能組出平衡的系統、取得電力，並維持足夠高的利用率來守住報酬。

text.en: AMD reported $6.7B in second-quarter data-center revenue, up 107% year over year, as EPYC demand and Instinct deployments scaled.
text.zh: AMD 公布第二季資料中心營收 $6.7B、年增 107%，EPYC 需求與 Instinct 部署同步擴大。

text.en: TSMC's second-quarter revenue reached the top of its guidance range while its third-quarter outlook moved higher; the result supports continued strength in the advanced compute supply chain.
text.zh: 台積電第二季營收達到指引區間上緣，第三季展望並向上推進，支持先進算力供應鏈需求仍強的判斷。

text.en: Cisco took $9.3B of hyperscaler AI infrastructure orders in its latest fiscal year, reinforcing the conversion of AI capacity plans into networking demand.
text.zh: Cisco 於最新會計年度取得 $9.3B 超大規模客戶 AI 基礎設施訂單，進一步支持 AI 容量規畫正轉化為網路需求。

text.en: OpenAI contracted for approximately 8 IT-GW at PORTS-Pike, which will exclusively host NVIDIA AI compute infrastructure.
text.zh: OpenAI 已簽約取得 PORTS-Pike 約 8 IT-GW 容量；該園區將專門部署 NVIDIA AI 算力基礎設施。

risks.en: Memory supply matters only after platform qualification. Track approved capacity rather than aggregate wafer starts.
risks.zh: 記憶體只有通過平台認證後才構成有效供應。應追蹤已核准產能，而非總晶圓投入量。

risks.en: The next profit pool belongs to operators that can keep expensive clusters fed, scheduled, and networked.
risks.zh: 下一個利潤池屬於能讓昂貴叢集持續有工作、排程順暢且網路充足的營運商。

risks.en: ASIC momentum is real, but software portability and deployment scale decide where share actually shifts.
risks.zh: ASIC 動能確實存在，但軟體可攜性與部署規模才決定市占真正轉移的位置。

nextObservations.zh: 下一讀 · 供應商組合
下一讀 · 工作負載密度

eyebrow.zh: 實體層 · 資料中心與能源

title.en: The AI race has entered the grid.

summary.en: A project-level view of power commitments, interconnection delays, cooling transitions, and the infrastructure required to turn models into capacity.
summary.zh: 以專案為單位追蹤電力承諾、併網延遲、冷卻轉型，以及把模型真正轉化為可用容量所需的基礎設施。

title.en: Signed megawatts are the new compute inventory.
title.zh: 已簽約兆瓦，就是新的算力庫存。

body.en: Data-center strategy is becoming an energy procurement discipline. Markets with available generation, faster permitting, and mature cooling supply chains can convert demand into revenue years earlier. The premium is shifting toward firm power, flexible load design, and campuses that can support higher rack density without delaying commissioning.
body.zh: 資料中心策略正轉變為能源採購專業。具備可用發電、較快許可流程與成熟冷卻供應鏈的市場，可以提早數年把需求轉成營收。溢價正轉向穩定電力、彈性負載設計，以及能在不延誤啟用的情況下支援更高機櫃密度的園區。

text.en: Vertiv reported second-quarter net sales growth of 24% year over year as demand for AI and general-compute power and thermal infrastructure intensified.
text.zh: Vertiv 公布第二季淨銷售額年增 24%，反映 AI 與一般運算的電力及散熱基礎設施需求升溫。

text.en: Vistra disclosed an initial commitment of up to $1.0B to Helix Digital Infrastructure and confirmed its role as Helix's preferred power provider.
text.zh: Vistra 揭露對 Helix Digital Infrastructure 的初始承諾最高達 $1.0B，並確認其為 Helix 的優先電力供應商。

text.en: OpenAI agreed to secure approximately 8 IT-GW at PORTS-Pike, while later phases remain dependent on new generation and transmission.
text.zh: OpenAI 同意在 PORTS-Pike 取得約 8 IT-GW 容量，後續階段仍取決於新建發電與輸電設施。

risks.en: Treat projects as real only after land, power, equipment, and customer commitments converge.
risks.zh: 只有在土地、電力、設備與客戶承諾同時到位後，才能把專案視為真實容量。

risks.en: Rack density is rising faster than retrofit readiness. Watch coolant distribution and heat rejection capacity.
risks.zh: 機櫃密度上升速度快於改造準備。應追蹤冷卻液配送與排熱能力。

risks.en: Gas, nuclear, storage, and demand response are converging into a new portfolio for always-on compute.
risks.zh: 天然氣、核能、儲能與需量反應正匯聚成全天候算力的新型供電組合。

nextObservations.zh: 下一讀 · Helix 專案轉化

eyebrow.zh: 應用層 · 模型與代理

title.en: Models are cheaper. Outcomes are not.
title.zh: 模型更便宜，成果並沒有。

summary.en: A commercial view of model price-performance, enterprise agent deployment, workflow ownership, and the unit economics separating pilots from production.
summary.zh: 從商業角度觀察模型性價比、企業代理部署、工作流程所有權，以及區分試點與正式環境的單位經濟。

title.en: The winning agent is a redesigned workflow, not a chat window.
title.zh: 勝出的代理是重新設計的工作流程，不是聊天視窗。

body.en: Model capability is converging faster than enterprise process change. Durable value appears where agents own a measurable task, operate against trusted context, escalate cleanly, and improve through feedback. As inference prices fall, distribution and workflow depth—not raw model access—capture a larger share of the economics.
body.zh: 模型能力的收斂速度快於企業流程改造。當代理負責可衡量的任務、使用可信情境、清楚升級例外，並透過回饋改善時，才會產生持久價值。推論價格下降後，分發與工作流程深度，而非單純模型存取，將取得更大比例的經濟價值。

text.en: OpenAI estimated that its expanded safety monitoring adds roughly 20% inference-compute overhead to monitored frontier training and evaluation workloads.
text.zh: OpenAI 估計，擴充後的安全監控會讓受監控的前沿訓練與評估工作負載增加約 20% 推論算力負擔。

risks.en: Measure completed work after review, not generated content. The gap exposes hidden operating cost.
risks.zh: 衡量覆核後真正完成的工作，而不是生成的內容。兩者差距會揭露隱藏營運成本。

risks.en: The most defensible agents learn from proprietary workflows without compromising governance.
risks.zh: 最具防禦力的代理能從專有工作流程學習，同時不犧牲治理。

risks.en: Outcome pricing expands upside but transfers model, review, and exception risk back to the vendor.
risks.zh: 成果定價提高上行空間，但也把模型、覆核與例外風險轉回供應商。

nextObservations.zh: 下一讀 · 監控算力負擔

eyebrow.zh: 材料層 · SiC 與功率半導體

title.en: AI’s power stack runs through SiC.
title.zh: AI 的電力堆疊，離不開 SiC。

summary.en: A weekly view of silicon carbide across AI chip packaging, eight-hundred-volt data-center power, EV inverters, wafer scaling, and the supply-chain contest shaping the next infrastructure cycle.
summary.zh: 每週追蹤碳化矽在 AI 晶片封裝、八百伏資料中心電力、電動車逆變器、晶圓擴徑與供應鏈競局中的最新變化。

title.en: SiC is moving from the EV red ocean into AI infrastructure.
title.zh: SiC 正從電動車紅海，移向 AI 基礎設施。

body.en: Twelve-inch SiC is no longer only an EV cost story. Its thermal conductivity, high-voltage performance, and compatibility with eight-hundred-volt data-center architectures create a second demand curve in AI packaging and power delivery. The opportunity depends on wafer quality, customer qualification, and how quickly advanced packaging moves from evaluation to production.
body.zh: 十二吋 SiC 已不只是電動車的降本題材。它的高導熱、高電壓性能，以及與八百伏資料中心架構的相容性，正於 AI 封裝與電力傳輸形成第二條需求曲線。機會能否落地，取決於晶圓品質、客戶認證，以及先進封裝從驗證走向量產的速度。

text.en: onsemi reported $1.604B of second-quarter revenue and said AI data-center revenue is expected to more than double this year as high-voltage power adoption broadens.
text.zh: onsemi 公布第二季營收 $1.604B，並表示隨高電壓電力方案採用擴大，今年 AI 資料中心營收預期成長逾一倍。

risks.en: Track named customer qualification and production orders, not wafer demonstrations. That is the bridge from technical proof to revenue.
risks.zh: 追蹤具名客戶認證與量產訂單，而不是晶圓展示。這才是從技術證明跨向營收的橋梁。

risks.en: The Wolfspeed–Navitas dispute could reshape design freedom and IP value across SiC and GaN power devices.
risks.zh: Wolfspeed 與 Navitas 的爭議，可能重塑 SiC 與 GaN 功率元件的設計自由與智慧財產價值。

risks.en: Watch reference designs become signed data-center orders. Power architecture adoption is the fastest path to material AI revenue.
risks.zh: 觀察參考設計能否變成已簽署的資料中心訂單。電力架構採用，是 AI 營收實質化的最快路徑。
